name: A Clue to Sanders' Treasure
summary: In Westfall, A Clue to Sanders' Treasure leads seekers farther along Captain Sanders' trail. It marks the second step in a hunt across the bluffs and coastlines.

sections.title: A Pirate's Riddle
sections.body:
After following Captain Sanders' first treasure map, you find a parchment pointing farther inland into Westfall. Its scrawled note sends you east from the coast and up the bluffs toward the main road.

Near crumbling stone ruins and an abandoned chimney, an old barrel marks where Sanders hid the next clue. The trail leads deeper into the troubled farmlands.

aliases: what is a clue to sanders treasure
faq.answer: Captain Sanders left a handwritten note to guide anyone clever enough to follow his trail to another hidden container in Westfall.
The clue sends you east from the coast and up the bluffs toward the Westfall road. An old barrel lies near a ruined chimney.
Captain Sanders was a pirate. His legacy lives on in the treasure caches and riddles he hid across Westfall's shores and countryside.
